Hi Lauren / team,

Thanks for the details and attachments. We reviewed AMZ-INV-987654 and the associated usage records. Summary of findings:

- The invoice contains two sets of charges: (A) direct marketplace metered charges tied to seller id 812-555-014, and (B) downstream reseller charges routed via AZR-RESELLER-204 (resale channel). The reseller-routing caused duplicate-seeming lines on the invoice when viewed against the seller-only metering export.
- We confirm there was a post-billing reseller allocation for ~€11,980 which appears as a routing adjustment on the invoice. That amount does not show in the seller-only metering CSV you provided.
- No VAT was charged on the reseller allocation line; VAT treatment on the invoice overall is mixed. We need vendor-supplied VAT documentation to apply reverse-charge adjustments where applicable.

Proposed next steps:
1) We can issue a marketplace credit for the reseller-routed allocation (credit proposal attached: aws-credit-proposal-20260216.pdf).
2) If Acme provides the VAT certificate and confirms reverse-charge, we will issue an adjusted invoice removing applied VAT where appropriate.
3) We will provide a line-level exported report mapping each invoice charge to the underlying meter_id and usage id within 3 business days.

Please confirm that Acme will accept the credit and provide VAT documents. Once we receive confirmation we’ll proceed with credit and adjusted invoice issuance.

Regards,
Marta Li
AWS Marketplace Billing Operations
